text:
Alex: Heads up — planned infra change Friday 2026-04-02 00:30 UTC. Routing v2 + IAM role pin. Need deploybot pin, release notes blurb, and explicit rollback criteria. Anyone object?

Deploybot: Scheduled run queued for 2026-04-02 00:30 UTC. To request a pin add `deploybot:pin=true` to the release ticket. Preflight will run 30m before.

Maya: Can we do a canary first (single AZ / 20% traffic) and observe for 30m? Would prefer less blast radius. :eyes: 

Sam: Yes — plan is staggered apply + traffic shift. Rough commands: 
```
git checkout release/routing-v2
terraform init
terraform plan -target=module.routing -out=plan.tfplan
terraform apply plan.tfplan
```
Providers are pinned in providers.tf (aws v3.12.0, terraform v1.5.x). We'll request a deploybot pin flag in the PR.

Sam: Canary flow: apply in canary tenant group -> shift 20% traffic -> wait 30m -> full 100% if metrics stable.

Carol: Heads-up — there's a DB migration scheduled same day at 01:00 UTC. Ops would prefer we finish earlier or move to 23:30 UTC to avoid overlap. @Sam can you shift?

Alex: Noted. If 23:30 works for infra team let's move it earlier. Avoid overlapping maintenance windows.

Sam: 23:30 UTC works for me. I'll update the release ticket and add the deploybot pin tag.

Taylor: Security check: any KMS key rotation or IAM boundary changes? If so we need a separate maintenance window.

Sam: No KMS rotation. We are adding a read-only role for service-x and a small trust-policy tweak for cross-account read. I'll attach the IAM diff to the PR for Taylor to sign off.

Alex: Rollback criteria proposal: immediate rollback if any of the following during canary or rollout:
- sustained 5xx increase >5% for 15m OR error budget spike >2%
- p95 latency shift >30s for routing service for 10m
- automated e2e test failures in the smoke suite

Rollback steps (manual if triggered):
1) revert release branch to `release/routing-v1` 
2) run `terraform apply -target=module.routing` with previous module ref
3) re-deploy routing service (restart pods, clear cache)
4) notify #incidents and escalate to oncall

Alex: We also want deploybot to auto-abort the rollout if preflight fails or if the canary check returns fail.

Deploybot: Auto-abort enabled. Abort thresholds set: 4 preflight failures within 10m triggers abort and notifies #eng-oncall. Canary healthcheck will run every 5m during the 30m window.

Maya: Add canary eviction rule: if 5xx > 0.5% during canary, drain canary nodes immediately and rollback traffic.

Sam: Will add that to the playbook. Also adding a quick exec script for oncall to run rollback: 
```
# rollback helper (in repo/tools)
./rollback.sh --module module.routing --ref release/routing-v1
```

Carol: Release notes snippet (short):
- routing v2: improved session affinity and reduced tail-latency regressions
- IAM: service-x read-only role for analytics pipeline

Carol: I'll update the full release notes and ping the migrations team about the DB window change.

Alex: Action items:
- Sam: update TF provider pins and add deploybot pin + rollback.sh to PR (ETA EOD Wed)
- Carol: update release notes and notify migrations team about window change
- Maya: be on-call for the window and run the canary watch
- Taylor: review IAM diff and sign off before deploy
- Alex: open deploybot ticket and enable auto-abort thresholds

Sam: I'll push the plan link and PR once ready: https://git.redwood/repo/commit/abc123 (plan shows 7 resources to change).

Deploybot: Preflight checks queued for 2026-04-02 23:00 UTC. Current preflight estimate: 8m.

Carol: :thumbsup:

Alex: Thanks all — keep this thread updated if anything changes.
